name: SCiEL: Sign uncertainty inequality
description: Construct Hermite expansion coefficients and a radius minimizing the sign-uncertainty bound c4 under the original root and positivity verification.

adaptation.verifier: finite real Hermite coefficients; even polynomial vanishing at origin with positive leading term; same-call strict symbolic verifier and numerical radius/score binding
adaptation.scope: Arena observes exactly one original constructor call and binds its returned construction to the same pinned scorer and named verifier inputs. Original scorer bytes are retained in upstream_evaluator.py. Missing or ambiguous observations stay unknown. These checks establish finite representation feasibility and numerical consistency, not a theorem, exact algebraic certificate, optimum or paper reproduction.

limitations: Source-inspected SCiEL example; not a reproduced paper result.
The original evaluator and baseline are fetched at the immutable source commit; no upstream implementation is silently repaired.
The original requirements.txt omits jax and optax imported by the baseline; both are included in this package’s actual dependency union.

Original scorer bytes are retained in upstream_evaluator.py. Missing or ambiguous observations stay unknown. These checks establish finite representation feasibility and numerical consistency, not a theorem, exact algebraic certificate, optimum or paper reproduction.

The original float conversion and binary-rational Hermite construction are preserved. Same-call strict verifier consistency uses atol=rtol=1e-9; this is finite-construction evidence, not an independently certified continuous uncertainty bound.

The unchanged strict symbolic verifier can reject otherwise meaningful coefficients when SymPy returns an explicit radical instead of a root object exposing eval_rational. Original verifier errors remain failed evaluations; the adapter does not silently repair the scorer.

run_single_trial.docstring: Runs one full optimization from a near-good starting point with small noise.

_build_P_from_hermite_coeffs.docstring: Build monomial-basis polynomial P from Hermite-basis coefficients.

_c4_from_hermite_coeffs.docstring: Compute r_max and C4 from full Hermite coefficient vector (Google-style).

get_c4_from_params.docstring: Calculates the precise C4 bound from a final set of parameters.

return_branches.expression: {'c4_bound': float(c4), 'combined_score': float(BENCHMARK / c4), 'r_max': float(rmax), 'coeffs': coeffs.tolist(), 'eval_time': float(t1 - t0)}

upstream_contract.validity_semantics: No independent boolean validity field; zero score, success rate and absence of error do not establish validity.

_objective_fn.docstring: Penalize negative values of P(x) on [0, Xmax]; mild weighting to emphasize larger x.

train_step.signature: params: jnp.ndarray, opt_state: optax.OptState, optimizer, hermite_basis, H_vals_at_zero, x_grid

upstream_contract.error_semantics: Original return branches are retained verbatim as source expressions. Some branches return score zero without error; some omit the primary score. Missing primary scores, exceptions, timeout and nonfinite JSON fail in the common adapter. An absent error field does not imply validity.

budgets.enforcement: These are original search/config budgets. Direct evaluation uses callable defaults and the common runner outer timeout; config max_iterations does not run a search.
